The '''Tangrene system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Morshdine sector/Legends|Morshdine sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tangrene]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Tangrene (species)|Tangrene]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
